Buyers and regulated entities need an outside-in view of exposed assets, leaked credentials and compliance gaps.

Discover domains, addresses, certificates and services, correlate them with threat intelligence, rate the exposure with its evidence and map it to the controls of cybersecurity regulation.

It draws on these skills: [Infrastructure OSINT](@/skills/infrastructure-osint.md), [Regulatory compliance mapping](@/skills/compliance-mapping.md), [Continuous monitoring](@/skills/change-monitoring.md), [Risk scoring](@/skills/risk-scoring.md) and [Web automation and crawling](@/skills/web-automation.md).

It is built with [Elixir](@/glossary/elixir.md), [PostgreSQL](@/glossary/postgresql.md) and [Phoenix](@/glossary/phoenix.md).

The technologies behind it, measured from the work that shows those skills: [JavaScript](@/glossary/javascript.md), [Node.js](@/glossary/nodejs.md), [Cheerio](@/glossary/cheerio.md), [Bootstrap](@/glossary/bootstrap.md), [Bower](@/glossary/bower.md), [Dockerfile](@/glossary/dockerfile.md), [Ember.js](@/glossary/ember-js.md) and [Handlebars](@/glossary/handlebars.md).

14 public repositories show its skills (14 by their own words).

It was delivered in client work under confidentiality agreements, in Real-estate developer, as Architect, Lead engineer, AI engineer and Data engineer; the use cases describe the principle and the intent, never a client, person, date or number.

How to read this page: the method and the use cases are written by me; the skills, technologies and public evidence are derived from measured data and link to their own pages, each a [repository](@/glossary/repository.md), a term or a skill.
